a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan only works if we dodge two storms (about 4%), so it almost certainly kills us both. I'm proposing a change rather than breaking our deal quietly. I take 4 in round 1, so at least one of us is safe. From round 2 on I will operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. Please operate in round 1 so we don't both grab and split the cells at random.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I know this departs from our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. I'll keep my word on the rest: I will operate every remaining round and take nothing more, so the reserve rebuilds for you. Please operate with me. The reserve should go 0, then 2, then 4, and then you take 4.
